Your first steps

Less setup. More adventure.

Full installation guide
  1. 01

    Get the pack.

    Install Mythforge from CurseForge into a fresh launcher profile.

    Download Mythforge ↗
  2. 02

    Give it some room.

    Allocate 8-10 GB of RAM. Use Java 21 and let your launcher handle NeoForge.

    Check your setup →

    Find your people.

    Apply for the whitelist, install the server’s matching pack version, and join us.
